description: A query_string full-text clause — the full Lucene query syntax (field prefixes, AND/OR/NOT, grouping, ranges, ~ fuzziness, ^ boosts, /regex/). Column names used as field prefixes inside query are resolved against the index schema; an unresolvable name is rejected.

fields.description: Optional. The columns to search. Each entry may carry a ^boost suffix (e.g. title^2). Defaults to default_field.

default_field.description: Optional. The column searched by terms that carry no field prefix.

default_operator.description: Optional. Boolean logic used between terms when no explicit operator is given: or (default) or and.

type.description: Optional. How the per-field matches are combined when fields lists more than one column: best_fields (default), most_fields, cross_fields, phrase, phrase_prefix, or bool_prefix.

analyzer.description: Optional. Analyzer used to tokenize the query text. Defaults to each field's search analyzer.

quote_analyzer.description: Optional. Analyzer used to tokenize the quoted (exact-phrase) portions of the query.

analyze_wildcard.description: Optional. Whether to analyze wildcard terms. Default false.

auto_generate_synonyms_phrase_query.description: Optional. Whether to auto-generate phrase queries for multi-term synonyms. Default true.

enable_position_increments.description: Optional. Whether positions are incremented for removed stop words. Default true.

fuzziness.description: Optional. Default allowed edit distance for ~ terms: an integer or AUTO.

fuzzy_max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms a fuzzy expansion will generate. Default 50.

fuzzy_prefix_length.description: Optional. Number of leading characters left unchanged when fuzzy matching.

fuzzy_transpositions.description: Optional. Whether to count transpositions (ab → ba) as a single edit. Default true.

lenient.description: Optional. When true, format-based errors are ignored.

max_determinized_states.description: Optional. Maximum number of automaton states a /regex/ term may compile to.

phrase_slop.description: Optional. Number of positions allowed between matching terms of a quoted phrase. Default 0.

quote_field_suffix.description: Optional. Suffix appended to field names for quoted (exact-phrase) portions of the query.

rewrite.description: Optional. How the multi-term query is rewritten internally.

time_zone.description: Optional. Time zone (e.g. -08:00 or America/Los_Angeles) used to interpret dates in range expressions.
